verdicts.reason: A breaks the original structure. The headline and subline sit top-left, the logo floats off-axis in the upper right, and the can and CTA sit on a third, centred axis, so nothing lines up and there is dead space everywhere. The headline is also tiny for a 768px canvas. B keeps the original can-left, text-right composition, but the top SOLSTICE logo is shrunk until you can't read it, and the CTA isn't left-aligned with the headline. The type is undersized, the subline floats far below the headline, and the bottom third is empty. B is still the more faithful and coherent of the two.
